notes.title: v1.4 update notes
notes.content:
[h2]What's new[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added 7 new chapters.
[*] Added a mini tps test chapter.
[*] The first chapter was remade in two parts to increase performance.
[*] Changed the way the pixel dlc version runs to save disk space.
[*] Known bugs fixed.
[*] Auto-save feature has been added between levels.
[/list]
